item.title: Bhatia’s big birdie runs helps him beat the wind and lead at Pebble Beach
item.description: Akshay Bhatia played Pebble Beach by the book in accommodating weather with such a blistering start that he threatened to run away with the tournament by building a five-shot lead at the turn. The post Bhatia’s big birdie runs helps him beat the wind and lead at Pebble Beach appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Aiken teen accused of stealing nude images from woman’s phone and posting them online
item.description: An Aiken teen was locked up this week for posting images of a woman using nude images from her stolen phone, authorities said. The post Aiken teen accused of stealing nude images from woman’s phone and posting them online appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta teen cleared in ‘Water Boys’ killing now wanted in armed kidnapping
item.description: An Augusta teen who was previously cleared in last summer’s high-profile “Water Boys” killing is now wanted in connection with a violent kidnapping involving a gun. item.title: War of words erupts over Fulton County elections after FBI raid
item.description: A verbal skirmish over Fulton County’s elections management unfolded at the Georgia Capitol Wednesday, as a Republican Senator said the state should take over the county elections office and the county’s Democratic leader ridiculed the notion as “laughable.” The post War of words erupts over Fulton County elections after FBI raid appeared first on The Augusta Press.
